WHERE LINKIIR FITS
Between your systems.
Behind every flow.
Grid is the integration layer that connects the systems you use to the data you need. Explore what happens inside.
EHRs · Labs · Payers · APIs · Files
01ConnectAdapters & transport+
Pre-tested adapters for EHRs, labs, PACS, pharmacy, clearinghouses, HIEs and data platforms. Connect through APIs, files or message brokers.
02TransformObjects & transformation+
HL7 v2, FHIR R4/R5, X12 and XML parse into typed objects. Use AI-assisted mapping, reusable libraries and real message samples to inspect and validate your data. Lua remains available for advanced customization.
03OrchestrateRoutes & durability+
Queue, acknowledge and archive messages. Route between systems, inspect failures and replay the messages that need another pass.
04GovernAccess & oversight+
Role-based access, encryption and audit trails keep control of the data flow. Monitor workflow health, queue depth and throughput from one console.
Clinical applications · Analytics · AI

AreaWhat to establish
InfrastructureOn-premises topology, Kubernetes or VM deployment, network access and ownership.
WorkloadPeak message volume, payload sizes, transformations and destination response times.

AI deploymentModel configuration, data access boundaries and the human verification process.
Production acceptanceRepresentative test messages, output validation, load testing and a staged cutover plan.

SECURITY & GOVERNANCE
Connected data.
Controlled access.
Protect messages with encryption in transit and at rest. Manage access with roles, MFA and SSO. Keep an audit trail of access and actions.
Review your deployment, access policies and data-handling requirements with your security team. Request Grid security documentation to support your assessment. Support can work from structure, metadata and error codes without patient data.
